pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
A Forest-themed defensive tool: right-click to block, negates all damage while consuming durability.

• Durability: 672. Enchantable: Unbreaking, Mending, Thorns, etc.
• Player blocking: reflects 2 thorns damage to attackers within 3 blocks (ignores armor) and applies infinite Poison to them

pages.title: Doll Use
pages.text:
When any doll holds the shield in its offhand, it reflects 100% of incoming damage (no blocking).

• A Forest doll additionally applies Poison III (10s) to the attacker
• Other doll variants only reflect, without poison
